title: Extension config
description: The data of an extension in extensions/. `npm run sync:extensions` derives the extension's files from it.

name.description: The extension's directory in extensions/. Also the default command ID prefix: `cSpellExt_<name>`.

friendlyName.description: The name shown to people, i.e. `Swedish`.

displayName.description: The Marketplace name. Default: `<friendlyName> - Code Spell Checker`.

description.description: The Marketplace description. Default: `<friendlyName> dictionary extension for VS Code.`

sample.description: The document opened by the VS Code test, relative to the extension.

engines.description: Overrides of the minimum versions in `static/engines.json`, i.e. `{ "cspell": ">=10.4.0" }`.

action.description: Turn the toggle on or off.

toggle.description: What the command changes: a locale (`cSpell.language`), a dictionary (`cSpell.dictionaries`), or a file type (`cSpell.enabledFileTypes`).

value.description: The locale, dictionary name, or file type (language ID).

scope.description: Where the setting is written. Not used by `fileType`. Default: `global`.

id.description: The command ID. Default: `cSpellExt_<name>.<action>`, with `Workspace` appended for the workspace scope.

title.description: The command title. Default: `<Action> <friendlyName> Spell Checker Dictionary`, with ` in Workspace` appended for the workspace scope.
